name: Royal Dispute
source:
Destined Prince or Demon King — who's going to be Princess Sonia's future partner? And what will befall the Kingdom of Almarune?

The princess listens. And you must decide who she listens to. This choice is not temporary. Once you lend your support, you will follow that path to its conclusion: through duty or defiance, destiny or freedom. Choose carefully.

[From [url=https://salamey.itch.io/royal-dispute]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
命中注定的王子还是魔王——谁会成为索尼娅公主未来的伴侣？阿尔玛鲁恩王国将会遭遇什么？

公主听着。你必须决定她听谁的。这个选择不是暂时的。一旦你提供支持，你就会沿着这条路到达终点：通过责任或反抗，通过命运或自由。仔细选择。

[来自[url=https://salamey.itch.io/royal-dispute]itch.io[/url]]
